mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, or if the correlation between GDP decline and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in a single month signals a strengthening demand environment, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of HOUST and UNRATE changes on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a single month signals a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) for three consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates monetary tightening.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the CPI increases for three consecutive months, or if the correlation between sustained CPI increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real retail and food services sales (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a strengthening demand environment, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of RSAFS and UNRATE changes on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
